name: vibe-memory
description: A shared, durable memory layer for ChatGPT Work, Codex, and other connected agents.

interface.longDescription: Give ChatGPT Work and your other agents one shared memory. Vibe Memory recalls relevant preferences and project context, preserves durable decisions and session checkpoints, maps agent-inferred entities and relationships, exchanges agent handoffs, and tracks product feedback through an OAuth-protected MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Recall the context that matters for my current work.
Continue this project from the latest saved checkpoint.
Save the durable decisions from this conversation.
